content.text: Most tutorials about [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/how-[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/how-building-crypto-store-[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/cloudflare-webhook-driven-crypto-payment-fulfillment-explained-digital-2|COREMERCH guide to cloudflare]]-pages-complete-infrastructure-3|How to]]-crypto-store-cloudflare-pages-works-how|building]] a digital store focus on the storefront. The storefront is the last thing you should configure. The backend is what makes the store work — and the backend is what most creators get wrong when they try to build without a clear sequence. In Stack 01, Google Apps Script serves as the backend Web App — it receives the NOWPayments webhook, validates the signature, confirms the transaction on-chain, logs the order to Google Sheets, and sends the delivery email via Gmail. In Stack 02, Cloudflare Workers replaces Apps Script with a faster, more scalable serverless backend that integrates natively with Supabase for order storage and Resend for email delivery. Configure the backend first, set the webhook endpoint URL in NOWPayments second, build the storefront third, and test on mainnet fourth.
Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

COREMERCH's Sovereign Commerce Infrastructure is not a workaround, but base-layer infrastructure. It's the digital equivalent of a brick and mortar store, where you own the land, the building, and the store. Unlike platforms like Stripe, PayPal, or Gumroad, you're not renting a space or relying on their terms. You own the keys to your commerce stack, including GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, and NOWPayments for automatic on-chain crypto payment verification. This is infrastructure sovereignty, not renting or subleasing.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before deploying your crypto store on Cloudflare Pages, you'll need to choose between Stack 01 and Stack 02. Stack 01, the Sovereign Starter Stack, is a DIY deployment that takes 4-6 hours to set up following the Sovereign Blueprint. Stack 02, the Edge Commerce Stack, is a pre-configured solution deployed by COREMERCH in 48 hours, end-to-end tested before handoff. You'll also need to prepare your digital product, set up a NOWPayments account, and configure your Cloudflare Pages domain.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

To set up your payment and delivery pipeline, first deploy your chosen stack on Cloudflare Pages. Next, configure your NOWPayments account to accept crypto payments. Then, set up a file delivery system using Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Finally, link your payment and delivery systems using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. This will enable automatic on-chain crypto payment verification and instant file delivery to your customers.
You own the keys to your commerce stack with COREMERCH's Sovereign Commerce Infrastructure.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once your payment and delivery pipeline is set up, you're ready to go live. Test your store on the Cloudflare Pages test environment, then move to the mainnet. Process your first transaction using NOWPayments, and verify that the payment is successful. Finally, deliver your digital product to your customer using your file delivery system. This will complete the first transaction and ensure that your infrastructure is working as expected.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

To scale your crypto store once the infrastructure is running, start by monitoring your traffic and adjusting your stack accordingly. You can add more products, increase your storage capacity, or upgrade your NOWPayments plan. Make sure to test your changes thoroughly before going live. Additionally, consider upgrading to the Edge Commerce Stack, which includes SPF/DKIM/DMARC configured and end-to-end testing for a more robust and secure commerce infrastructure.

The difference between Stack 01 and Stack 02 is not which one works — both work — it is which one fits your situation. Stack 01 is the right choice if you want to deploy yourself, you are comfortable with Google Workspace tools, and your initial volume is under 100 orders per day. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 documents the complete Stack 01 build with full source code and step-by-step configuration. Stack 02 is the right choice if you want the deployment done for you, you need higher volume capacity, or you want email deliverability infrastructure configured from day one. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 has COREMERCH deploy Stack 02 under your accounts in 48 hours, end-to-end tested before handoff. Both are available at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
This solution works when platforms fail and provides infrastructure sovereignty.

This solution is deployed by COREMERCH in 48 hours and provides a more robust and secure commerce infrastructure. Check out COREMERCH's products at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

To deploy a crypto store on Cloudflare Pages, follow these steps: Deploy your chosen stack on Cloudflare Pages, configure your NOWPayments account, set up a file delivery system, link your payment and delivery systems, test your store on the Cloudflare Pages test environment, move to the mainnet, process your first transaction, and verify the payment success. Additionally, monitor your traffic and adjust your stack accordingly. Consider upgrading to the Edge Commerce Stack for a more robust and secure commerce infrastructure.
